preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner
Contract must hold some BNB balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the clearStuckBalance_sender() function with amountPercentage set to 100 to drain all BNB from the contract to your address. This function is marked 'authorized' and allows the caller to transfer any percentage of the contract's BNB balance to themselves.
